name: the-intention-gap-website
description: Public research website for The Intention Gap (static; built from the repository's frozen public outputs).

scripts.build: npm run data && npm run check:data && astro build && node scripts/check-text.mjs && node scripts/check-indexing.mjs
scripts.build:pages: npm run data && npm run check:data && astro build --base /the-intention-gap/ && node scripts/check-text.mjs && node scripts/check-indexing.mjs
